name: Compatibility, evolvability and change safety
composition_owner: none found for COMPAT-X (policy + registries, production delta 0; qualification code mirrors the policy). EVOL-X change workflow is composed outside the shipped package: testing_support/change_safety/workflow.py with CLI scripts/qualification/evol_x_change_workflow.py (zone S per EVOL doc).

risks.text: Three complementary version registries (CONTRACT_SCHEMA_REGISTRY, RUNTIME_SCHEMA_REGISTRY, event payload registry) by design; COMPAT-X doc states there is no universal registry. Recorded as documented, not a defect.

EVOL-X change safety (impact graph, regression selection, deploy assessors) is implemented entirely in testing_support/ and scripts/qualification/; no shipped-package enforcement point. It is advisory change-time tooling; FRZ-EVOL-06..10 are OFF_VOCAB in the checklist.

Temporary compatibility seams present in frozen scope (intergrax/compat/langchain, intergrax/legacy/rag_answers) are classified by the COMPAT-X R5 inventory; FRZ-DEBT-03 (temporary seam in frozen scope = 0) is OPEN under ARCH-FREEZE.
Owner doc status lines are stale (EVOL-X architecture still says W1 draft ADR / pending approval while the roadmap records EVOL-X CLOSED). See finding f1.

Evaluation: intergrax/applications/_shared/evaluation_wiring.py (PDC D5 composition owner; wires only the online evaluation registry, see risk). risks.text: Evaluation spans four code families: intergrax/eval (EvalRunner, typed_run), intergrax/runtime/architecture (online_evaluation_*, evaluation_assets/automation, agent_promotion), intergrax/runtime/evidence (eval_evidence_*) and intergrax/runtime/evaluation (one orphan module without __init__.py). PDC inventory names eval/ and runtime/architecture/ as D5 semantic owners while the PDC ownership matrix names new contracts/evaluation_* as the owner; ADR-PDC-05 resolves toward typed contracts but keeps legacy runners. Known PDC audit item F-D5-06.

The PDC-named D5 composition owner evaluation_wiring.py references none of typed_run, evaluation_contracts or intergrax.eval (grep count 0 in evaluation_wiring, evaluation_runtime_bridge, evaluation_assembly_resolver); the typed run entry point execute_eval_run has callers only in tests and an evidence probe.

QUAL-X has no architecture-layer owner doc; its owner is a qualification record (status line shows closure population A only). Enterprise-audit architecture status text is stale. See findings f1 and f4.

Promotion gate self-test passes with a fabricated string reference (eval/echo/baseline-2026.json): the gate checks presence of evaluation_report_refs strings only (ADR-PDC-05 context: gates check that files exist). Advisory PASS cannot authorize promotion per D5 repair tests (xd08).

name: Hosting and application tier (Tier-3)
composition_owner: Hosting lifecycle: intergrax/hosting/runner.py::run_hosted_application (PDC D4 root). Tier-3 environment: intergrax/applications/_shared/environment_wiring.py::wire_application_environment. Per-application hosts: applications/*/host/factory.py + wiring.py (9 applications), shared assembly intergrax/applications/_shared/harness_host_runtime.py (830 lines). No single root: two documented domain roots plus per-app roots.
dependencies: C24 (proof receipts consumed by LKW proofs)

risks.text: Only one Tier-3 path uses the D4 composition root run_hosted_application (local_workspace_application/hosting/foreground.py). At least six application entrypoints start serving with a direct uvicorn.run (attestation_demo, intergrax_assistant, lab, research, local_workspace host/main.py, governed_contractor package_b serving command); no doc states that direct uvicorn serving is an accepted second lifecycle path. APPLICATION_HOSTING names LKW only as first adopter.

Per-application host factories (9 applications/*/host/factory.py) plus shared intergrax/applications/_shared (344 files, several *_host_*composition modules). DUP-X recorded a dedupe disposition for the 9 hosts; this audit did not re-derive it.

PDC ownership matrix says applications/contracts/application_artifacts.py is removed under COMPAT-X R5; at the baseline it exists as a re-export shim with no importers. Matrix status is still draft/pending while ADR-PDC-04/05 are Accepted. See finding f1.
intergrax/supervisor (LangGraph planning prototype) and intergrax/hosting/supervisor (in-process lifecycle supervisor) share a name; PDC matrix distinguishes them, no code gate shown here.

name: Proof receipts and evidence plane
composition_owner: No single root. LKW-style receipts: callers construct ProofReceiptStore(document_store) (applications/local_workspace_application/scripts/run-lkw-*-proof.py). Host-attested execution evidence: intergrax/runtime/execution_evidence/compose.py. Artifact bundles: intergrax/runtime/execution/run_artifact_bundle_composition.py (PDC D8 root). Tier-3 governed contractor: applications/governed_contractor_application/host/stores.py (own store Protocol).
certifications: PROOF-RECEIPTS-1A..1E (domain plan phases; not roadmap stage IDs)

risks.text: Two unrelated Pydantic classes are both named ProofReceipt (DocumentStore LKW receipt vs host-attested execution-evidence receipt; the latter also has ProofReceiptV2) and two ProofReceiptStore definitions exist (platform class vs Tier-3 governed_contractor Protocol). PROOF_RECEIPTS.md claims the platform owns the ProofReceipt model without mentioning the second model; consumers disambiguate by alias (ExecutionEvidenceProofReceipt). DUP-X records do not mention ProofReceipt.

The evidence plane (runtime/evidence, runtime/execution_evidence) is owned by a plan document (HARNESS_EVIDENCE_PACK) and ADR/security satellites, not by an architecture-layer doc; PDC inventory classes runtime/evidence as PLATFORM-FOUNDATION INDEX_ONLY while the ownership matrix names it the D8 evidence-plane owner.

Protocol-v2 receipt invariants (source revision, dirty-state, environment fingerprint) are documented as accepted/planned and not implemented; the ProofReceipt model has none of these fields (freeform metadata only); provenance exists separately in core/qualification validity persistence.

Tier-3 governed_contractor_application persists execution-evidence receipts through its own SQLite/in-memory stores rather than a platform store port (documented as PROD-Q R1-R7-Q decisions); not assessed here.

coverage_note: Read PROOF_RECEIPTS section B/N, ProofReceipt class heads of both models, store signatures, execution_evidence package head, PDC ownership D8 row, test dir listing; grep for ProofReceiptStore definitions and importers of intergrax.proofs. Did not read runtime/evidence runners, DocumentStore providers, receipt serialization tests or run any test.
notes: Three mechanisms: (1) DocumentStore ProofReceipt for LKW proofs, (2) host-attested ProofReceipt/V2 execution evidence, (3) harness evidence pack contracts. They serve different purposes; the gap is naming and the lack of one reconciling owner doc.
